title: Work with Veranda the way that works for you.
body: Take the full platform as a turnkey solution, pick only the parts you need, or meet us in the middle with something built just for you.

models.title: Complete solution
models.body: Launch a secure access program without building anything yourself. We supply the enclosure, hardware, software, and support as one ready-to-run system.

models.title: White label
models.body: Bring a proven product to market under your own name, in a fraction of the time it takes to build one. You own the brand and the customer; we power everything underneath.

models.title: Custom development
models.body: A solution designed around your product. Our engineers work alongside yours to build custom hardware and software for requirements that no off-the-shelf product meets.

models.title: Technology licensing
models.body: Put Veranda's technology inside your own product line. License the platform and ship access, monitoring, and automation as features of products you already sell.

models.title: Component integration
models.body: Fill the gap in the systems you already run. Add a single lock or sensor board, or connect one software service, without replacing what already works.
